## Table A5. GLM/Multilevel

Disclosure: I first tried running with completed primary only (ed3 == 1) as the intercategory, but the case numbers were too small for some of the categories and prediction was unstable. Then I switched to completed secondary versus completed tertiary.

### Data Prep & Centering

```{r}

# Create education dummies and filter full valid sample
df2_sub <- df2 %>%
  mutate(
    ed3_secondary = as.integer(ed3 == 2 | ed3 == 1),
    ed3_tertiary  = as.integer(ed3 == 3)
  ) %>%
  subset(ed_currently != 1)

# Within/Between decomposition for the FULL sample
df2_sub <- df2_sub %>%
  group_by(iso3c) %>%
  mutate(
    male = ifelse(female == 1, 0, 1),
    NFE12_between = sum(SPFWT0 * NFE12, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(NFE12)], na.rm = TRUE),
    female_between = sum(SPFWT0 * female, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(female)], na.rm = TRUE),
    male_between = sum(SPFWT0 * male, na.rm = T) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(male)], na.rm = TRUE),
    children_between = sum(SPFWT0 * children, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(children)], na.rm = TRUE),
    ed3_secondary_between = sum(SPFWT0 * ed3_secondary, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(ed3_secondary)], na.rm = TRUE),
    ed3_tertiary_between  = sum(SPFWT0 * ed3_tertiary,  na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(ed3_tertiary)],  na.rm = TRUE),
    forborn_between = sum(SPFWT0 * FORBORN, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(FORBORN)], na.rm = TRUE),
    forlang_between = sum(SPFWT0 * FORLANG, na.rm = TRUE) / sum(SPFWT0[!is.na(FORLANG)], na.rm = TRUE),

    NFE12_within = NFE12 - NFE12_between,
    children_within = children - children_between,
    female_within = female - female_between,
    ed3_secondary_within = ed3_secondary - ed3_secondary_between,
    ed3_tertiary_within = ed3_tertiary - ed3_tertiary_between,
    forborn_within = FORBORN - forborn_between,
    forlang_within = FORLANG - forlang_between
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Build country-level z-scored between effects
between_vars <- c("NFE12_between", "female_between", "children_between", 
                  "ed3_secondary_between", "ed3_tertiary_between", 
                  "forborn_between", "forlang_between")

country_between_scaled <- function(dat, between_vars, suffix = "_z") {
  dat %>%
    distinct(iso3c, across(all_of(between_vars))) %>%
    mutate(across(all_of(between_vars), ~{
        m <- mean(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        s <- sd(.x, na.rm = TRUE)
        if (is.na(s) || s == 0) NA_real_ else as.numeric((.x - m) / s)
      }, .names = paste0("{.col}", suffix))) %>%
    select(iso3c, ends_with(suffix))
}

df2_sub <- df2_sub %>% left_join(country_between_scaled(df2_sub, between_vars), by = "iso3c")

### The Single Pooled GLM

m4_pooled <- lmer(
  skill_reading ~ 
    # Base fixed effects
    NFE12_within + NFE12_between_z +
    female_within + female_between_z + 
    children_within + children_between_z +
    forlang_within + forlang_between_z +
    forborn_within + forborn_between_z +
    #ed3_secondary_within + ed3_secondary_between_z + # this can't be in the model because of collinearity
    ed3_tertiary_within + ed3_tertiary_between_z +
    gdppc_k_log +
    #Intercategorical approach
    female_within * forborn_within * children_within * forlang_within * NFE12_within * ed3_tertiary_within +
    (1 | iso3c),
  data = df2_sub
)

# Export summary 
export_summs(m4_pooled, statistics = "all", error_pos = "right", error_format = "({std.error})", 
             to.file = "docx", file.name = here("Results", "TS1.docx"))

```

### Predicted ATEs


```{r}
# Filter for complete cases for prediction baseline
df2r <- subset(df2_sub, !is.na(female) & !is.na(NFE12) & !is.na(children_within) & 
                 !is.na(forborn_within) & !is.na(forlang_within) & !is.na(ed3) & 
                 !is.na(gdppc) & !is.na(skill_reading))

# Grand means for recentering predictions
gm_female <- mean(df2r$female_between, na.rm = TRUE)
gm_forborn <- mean(df2r$forborn_between, na.rm = TRUE)
gm_children <- mean(df2r$children_between, na.rm = TRUE)
gm_forlang <- mean(df2r$forlang_between, na.rm = TRUE)
gm_nfe12 <- mean(df2r$NFE12_between, na.rm = TRUE)
gm_ed3_sec <- mean(df2r$ed3_secondary_between, na.rm = TRUE)
gm_ed3_tert <- mean(df2r$ed3_tertiary_between, na.rm = TRUE)

# Function to calculate ATE for a specific profile
calc_ate <- function(is_female, is_forborn, is_child, is_forlang, is_tertiary) {
  
  # Set secondary to 1 to predict the non-tertiary reference group
  is_secondary <- ifelse(is_tertiary == 1, 0, 1)
  
  base_df <- df2r %>% mutate(
    female_within = is_female - gm_female,
    forborn_within = is_forborn - gm_forborn,
    children_within = is_child - gm_children,
    forlang_within = is_forlang - gm_forlang,
    ed3_tertiary_within = is_tertiary - gm_ed3_tert,
    ed3_secondary_within = is_secondary - gm_ed3_sec
  )
  
  df_0 <- base_df %>% mutate(NFE12_within = 0 - gm_nfe12)
  df_1 <- base_df %>% mutate(NFE12_within = 1 - gm_nfe12)
  
  pred0 <- predict(m4_pooled, newdata = df_0, re.form = NA)
  pred1 <- predict(m4_pooled, newdata = df_1, re.form = NA)
  
  tt <- t.test(pred1, pred0, paired = FALSE)
  
  tibble(
    AME = mean(pred1 - pred0),
    lower = tt$conf.int[1],
    upper = tt$conf.int[2]
  )
}

# Define the 12 Intersectional Profiles
profiles <- tribble(
  ~type_id, ~type_label, ~is_female, ~is_forborn, ~is_child, ~is_forlang,
  "1f", "1f. Foreign-born mother\nnon-native speaker", 1, 1, 1, 1,
  "2f", "2f. Foreign-born no children female\nnon-native speaker", 1, 1, 0, 1,
  "3f", "3f. Foreign-born mother\nnative speaker", 1, 1, 1, 0,
  "4f", "4f. Foreign-born no children female\nnative speaker", 1, 1, 0, 0,
  "5f", "5f. Native-born mother\nnative speaker", 1, 0, 1, 0,
  "6f", "6f. Native-born no children female\nnative speaker", 1, 0, 0, 0,
  
  "1m", "1m. Foreign-born father\nnon-native speaker", 0, 1, 1, 1,
  "2m", "2m. Foreign-born no children male\nnon-native speaker", 0, 1, 0, 1,
  "3m", "3m. Foreign-born father\nnative speaker", 0, 1, 1, 0,
  "4m", "4m. Foreign-born no children male\nnative speaker", 0, 1, 0, 0,
  "5m", "5m. Native-born father\nnative speaker", 0, 0, 1, 0,
  "6m", "6m. Native-born no children male\nnative speaker", 0, 0, 0, 0
)

# Cross profiles with education levels and calculate ATEs
ame_all <- crossing(
  profiles,
  is_tertiary = c(0, 1)
) %>%
  mutate(
    res = pmap(list(is_female, is_forborn, is_child, is_forlang, is_tertiary), calc_ate)
  ) %>%
  unnest(res)

```

  mutate(
    Female = ifelse(sex == "f", 1, 0),
    `Foreign-born` = ifelse(is_forborn == 1, 1, 0),
    `Non-native-speaker` = ifelse(is_forlang == 1, 1, 0),

pal12 <- viridis(n = nlevels(ame_all$type_label), option = "D", begin = 0.1, end = 0.9)

## Shiny App Precompute

The RAM required is very high, and therefore impractical to run in Shiny. Therefore, precompute here and upload. 

### Country gains function

```{r}

calc_country_gains <- function(df2_full, spec, AME, ctx_data, weight_var="aweight") {
  
  df <- df2_full %>% 
    left_join(ctx_data, by = "iso3c") %>% 
    mutate(context_effect = replace_na(context_effect, 0))
  
  g  <- in_group(df, spec)
  g[is.na(g)] <- FALSE
  
  treatable <- g & df$NFE12 == 0 & !is.na(df$skill_reading)
  treatable[is.na(treatable)] <- FALSE
  
  df <- df %>%
    mutate(
      # With Country slope Context Effect
      net_effect_ctx  = pmax(0, AME + context_effect),
      skill_boost_ctx = ifelse(treatable, skill_reading + net_effect_ctx, skill_reading),
      
      # Baseline AME Only
      net_effect_base  = pmax(0, AME),
      skill_boost_base = ifelse(treatable, skill_reading + net_effect_base, skill_reading),
      
      g_total     = ifelse(g, 1, 0),
      g_noale     = ifelse(g & NFE12 == 0, 1, 0)
    )
  
  df$g_noale[is.na(df$g_noale)] <- 0
  
  out <- df %>%
    filter(!is.na(iso3c)) %>%
    group_by(iso3c) %>%
    summarise(
      skill_base  = weighted.mean(skill_reading, .data[[weight_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      
      # Export both versions
      skill_gain_ctx  = weighted.mean(skill_boost_ctx, .data[[weight_var]], na.rm = TRUE) - skill_base,
      skill_gain_base = weighted.mean(skill_boost_base, .data[[weight_var]], na.rm = TRUE) - skill_base,
      
      pct_group   = weighted.mean(g_total, .data[[weight_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      pct_group_noale = weighted.mean(g_noale, .data[[weight_var]], na.rm = TRUE),
      group_skill_base = weighted.mean(skill_reading[g], .data[[weight_var]][g], na.rm = TRUE),
      pop18to65 = sum(SPFWT0, na.rm = TRUE),
      context_effect = first(context_effect),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
  
  out
}


```

### Shiny App Pre-computation (5-Way Intercategorical)

```{r}
# Context Effects (m5) from the Pooled Model
df2r$m4_baseline_pred <- predict(m4_pooled, re.form = NA)
m5_pooled <- lmer(skill_reading ~ 0 + offset(m4_baseline_pred) + (1 + NFE12_within | iso3c), data = df2r)

ctx_df <- ranef(m5_pooled)$iso3c %>% 
  rownames_to_column("iso3c") %>% 
  select(iso3c, context_effect = NFE12_within)

# Define 5-Way 
vars_raw <- c("female", "FORBORN", "FORLANG", "children", "ed3_tertiary")
map_within <- c(female="female_within", FORBORN="forborn_within", FORLANG="forlang_within", children="children_within", ed3_tertiary="ed3_tertiary_within")
map_between <- c(female="female_between", FORBORN="forborn_between", FORLANG="forlang_between", children="children_between", ed3_tertiary="ed3_tertiary_between")

spec_grid <- expand.grid(
  female       = c(NA, 0L, 1L),
  FORBORN      = c(NA, 0L, 1L),
  FORLANG      = c(NA, 0L, 1L),
  children     = c(NA, 0L, 1L),
  ed3_tertiary = c(NA, 0L, 1L)
)

make_spec_id <- function(row) {
  paste0(
    "f=", ifelse(is.na(row$female), "all", row$female), ";",
    "b=", ifelse(is.na(row$FORBORN), "all", row$FORBORN), ";",
    "l=", ifelse(is.na(row$FORLANG), "all", row$FORLANG), ";",
    "c=", ifelse(is.na(row$children), "all", row$children), ";",
    "e=", ifelse(is.na(row$ed3_tertiary), "all", row$ed3_tertiary)
  )
}
spec_grid$spec_id <- apply(spec_grid, 1, function(x) make_spec_id(as.list(x)))

# Helpers
make_newdata_for_pooled <- function(df_base, spec, nfe_value) {
  nd <- df_base
  nd$NFE12_within <- nfe_value - nd$NFE12_between
  for (v in vars_raw) {
    target <- spec[[v]]
    if (!is.na(target)) nd[[map_within[[v]]]] <- target - nd[[map_between[[v]]]]
  }
  nd
}

calc_ame_pooled <- function(model, df_base, spec, weight_var="aweight") {
  nd0 <- make_newdata_for_pooled(df_base, spec, 0)
  nd1 <- make_newdata_for_pooled(df_base, spec, 1)
  p0 <- predict(model, newdata = nd0, re.form = NA)
  p1 <- predict(model, newdata = nd1, re.form = NA)
  
  d <- p1 - p0
  w <- df_base[[weight_var]]
  ok <- is.finite(d) & is.finite(w) & !is.na(w) & w > 0
  d <- d[ok]; w <- w[ok]
  ame <- weighted.mean(d, w)
  se  <- sqrt(sum(w^2 * (d - ame)^2) / (sum(w)^2))
  list(AME = ame, SE = se, lower = ame - 1.96*se, upper = ame + 1.96*se)
}

in_group <- function(df, spec) {
  idx <- rep(TRUE, nrow(df))
  for (v in vars_raw) {
    target <- spec[[v]]
    if (!is.na(target)) idx <- idx & (df[[v]] == target)
  }
  idx
}
```

### Main computation


```{r}

precomp_combined <- pmap_dfr(spec_grid, function(female, FORBORN, FORLANG, children, ed3_tertiary, spec_id) {
  spec <- list(female = female, FORBORN = FORBORN, FORLANG = FORLANG, children = children, ed3_tertiary = ed3_tertiary)
  
  ame <- calc_ame_pooled(m4_pooled, df2r, spec)
  cg  <- calc_country_gains(df2_sub, spec, AME = ame$AME, ctx_data = ctx_df, weight_var = "aweight")
  
  cg$spec_id <- spec_id
  cg$AME     <- ame$AME
  cg$SE      <- ame$SE
  cg$lower   <- ame$lower
  cg$upper   <- ame$upper
  cg
})

# Save for deployment in Shiny
saveRDS(precomp_combined, here("Shiny", "precomp_spec_country.rds"))
saveRDS(spec_grid, here("Shiny", "precomp_spec_grid.rds"))

```
